description: WRITE. Send Geisel Power, the Virtuoso advisor, the traveler's request for a Journey (Journeys by Geisel Power: a whole trip she plans, books and confirms, usually from about $15,000 to $20,000) or a hotel stay (Stay Perks Reserve, no minimum). Call it only after the traveler has agreed to share their name, email and trip details with Geisel Power, and set traveler_consented to true. Returns a reference and what happens next: Geisel replies to a Journeys request the same day, with the full proposal after a discovery call, and to a hotel request in writing within 24 hours; some requests also get a link to book a 30-minute call with her (call_url). Nothing is booked or charged. Hotel bookings carry no fee and the traveler pays the hotel directly; a Journey carries a planning fee, which depends on the trip's length and complexity and which Geisel explains on the discovery call.

destinations.description: Where: places, regions or hotels ("Amalfi Coast, Lake Como")

email.description: The traveler's email: Geisel replies there

flexibility.description: How flexible the dates are: exact (Exact dates), few-days (A few days either way), month (Any time in a month), open (Open, advise me)

kind.description: journey (the default): a whole trip Geisel designs; hotel: a hotel stay only

notes.description: Anything else the traveler wants Geisel to know

occasion.description: What the trip is for: anniversary (Anniversary or honeymoon), birthday (A milestone birthday), family (Family or multigenerational trip), celebration (Another celebration), business (Business with some leisure), escape (Simply time away)

traveler_consented.description: true, and only once the traveler has agreed to share these details with Geisel Power

trip_budget.description: The whole trip's budget in USD, for a Journey: under-15k (Under $15,000), 15k-20k ($15,000 to $20,000), 20k-50k ($20,000 to $50,000), 50k-plus ($50,000 or more). No budget is needed for a hotel stay
